_comment: Per-building corrections and 3D features, written while recreating a building from Street View (.claude/skills/recreate-building). Keys are building ids as in data/hero/coverage.json. tags: OSM tag overrides (roof:shape, roof:height, height, building:levels, ...). roof: a covering from data/roofs.json. features: 3D things on or in front of a wall; see the skill for every type.
